## Result

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue; use `Closes #...`
only when all of its delivery conditions are satisfied.

## Validation

Record relevant checks and evidence: ROM hash, tools, machine, RAM/VRAM, cartridge,
reference revision/region, settings, scenario and verdict where applicable.

## Remaining limits

Distinguish automated checks, emulator acceptance and physical-machine validation.
Do not publish original research ROMs or supplied third-party source by accident.
